tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: List cities where Fless operates (live + coming soon). Returns ids needed for hunts.

tools.name: get_city_overview
tools.description: Neighborhood-level overview of a live city: median rents (1BR/2BR), walk/transit/bike scores per neighborhood.

tools.name: get_neighborhood
tools.description: Full detail for one neighborhood: rents, scores, POI counts, descriptions, nearby neighborhoods.

tools.name: get_hunt_requirements
tools.description: Every hunt field, enum, and rule; canonical amenity keys; binary restrictions (55+, pets, smoking); transparent credit pricing. Read this before collecting a hunt brief.

tools.name: build_hunt_link
tools.description: Validate a hunt brief and get a URL that pre-fills the full hunt form for the human. Works with partial briefs (missing_fields lists what to collect).

tools.name: check_hunt_link
tools.description: Aggregate status of a hunt link (created/opened/started) — no personal data.

tools.name: request_city
tools.description: Request that Fless expand to a new city. Use when the user's target city is not currently served (check live coverage first with search_cities). Returns the total request count for that city. No account or email needed.

tools.name: get_city_request_stats
tools.description: See which cities have been requested most. Useful for telling users whether their city has demand.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Fless content (cities, neighborhoods, hunt guide). Returns citable ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch full content by id from search: markdown text + canonical url for citations.

tools.name: submit_error_report
tools.description: Report a problem with Fless tools or data so we can fix it. Include: the tool you called, the error code from the error contract if present, what happened vs what you expected. Do NOT include personal data.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_hunt_link, request_city, fetch, realtor_list_clients · Private data: realtor_list_clients, realtor_create_client, realtor_create_hunt, realtor_list_candidate_buildings, realtor_curate_hunt, realtor_add_building_to_hunt, realtor_send_to_client, realtor_get_hunt_status · Public sink: request_city, submit_error_report, realtor_list_clients, realtor_create_client, realtor_send_to_client.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_hunt_link, request_city, fetch, realtor_list_clients · Private data: realtor_list_clients, realtor_create_client, realtor_create_hunt, realtor_list_candidate_buildings, realtor_curate_hunt, realtor_add_building_to_hunt, realtor_send_to_client, realtor_get_hunt_status · Public sink: request_city, submit_error_report, realtor_list_clients, realtor_create_client, realtor_send_to_client

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_city" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Request that Fless expand to a new city. Use when the user's target city is not currently served (Washington, DC / Maryland / Virginia only). Returns the total request count for that city. No account or email needed." → after: "Request that Fless expand to a new city. Use when the user's target city is not currently served (check live coverage first with search_cities). Returns the total request count for that city. No account or email needed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
